onboarding.welcomeBody: Short, playful music activities and sound tools to use with your child, based on research about music and sound for autistic children.
onboarding.is1: 10–15 minutes a day of music you make together.
onboarding.is2: Help with sounds your child finds hard, at your child's pace.
onboarding.is3: Honest information about what research does and does not show.

consent.title: Your family's privacy
consent.storedTitle: What we store (on this phone only)
consent.stored1: A nickname for your child and their age range.
consent.stored2: Your short logs: music sessions, goals and the sound diary.
consent.stored3: Any voice recordings you choose to make.
consent.never1: We never send your child's data anywhere. There is no account and no cloud.
consent.never2: No ads, no trackers, and we never sell data.
consent.never3: We never ask for your child's name, birth date, photo or diagnosis.
consent.control: You can download or delete everything at any time in Settings. Logs are removed automatically after 12 months (the sound diary after 90 days).
consent.adultCheck: I'm the parent or guardian: start the adult check
consent.ack: I am this child's parent or guardian, and I agree to this information being stored on this device.

profile.title: About your child
profile.minimal: We only ask what we need to suggest activities.

goals.pickBody: Goals help us suggest activities and show how things are going. You can skip this and add goals later.
goals.title: Goals
goals.none: You have no goals yet. Add one to start logging.
goals.loggedToday: You already logged today. You can add another if you like.

today.title: Hi {name}! Today's plan
today.together: You played together {n} times this week. Any day you play together counts.

session.title: Session
session.noPlan: Add your child's details to get a plan.
session.logBody: Three quick taps. There are no scores, just what happened.
session.anyDay: Any day you play together counts.

activities.title: Activities
activities.intro: Short music games grouped by what they practise. Pick any. There is no wrong way to play.

routines.intro: Use the same short song every time for a routine. The same song makes the routine predictable.
routines.myVoiceBody: Record yourself singing (up to 20 seconds). It stays on this phone and plays at a safe level in Child Mode.
routines.micError: We couldn't use the microphone. Check permissions and try again.
routines.needConsent: Please give consent in Settings first.

sound.title: Sound toolkit
sound.intro: Tools to protect your child from sound overload and, gently and only at their pace, build comfort and control.

diary.intro: Log a sound in under 30 seconds. After 1–2 weeks, patterns show which sounds are hardest.
diary.expected: Did your child know it was coming?

patterns.needMore: You have {n} entries. Patterns are clearer after about a week (7 or more).
patterns.summary: {hard} of {total} sounds upset your child. {unexpected} of those were unexpected.

countdown.body: A silent countdown before a noisy thing, like the blender or the hand dryer. Your child can press start.

tooLoud.text: Too loud. I need a break.

exposure.rule1: Only with a grown-up present, during a favourite activity. Stop any time.
exposure.rule2: It starts very softly. It can go up by one small step ({step} dB) at most, on another day, and only if your child was calm.
exposure.rule3: If your child presses Stop, or you rate them 3 or more, it stops at once and next time starts quieter.
exposure.rule4: Two stops in a row pause practice for 24 hours. Consider talking to your child's OT or audiologist.
exposure.locked: Practice is paused for 24 hours after two stops in a row. That's OK. Consider asking your child's OT or audiologist for ideas.
exposure.present: I'm with my child now, and they are doing something they enjoy.
exposure.playing: Playing softly at {db} dBFS. Watch your child.
exposure.checkin: How is your child right now?
exposure.stepUp: Finish, one small step louder next time
exposure.stopped: Stopped. Next time will start quieter. You did the right thing.
exposure.stoppedDistress: Stopped because your child was upset. Next time will start quieter.
exposure.done: Well done. Same level next time.
exposure.doneUp: Well done. Next time will be one small step louder.

refused.caregiver-not-present: Please confirm you are with your child.
refused.no-consent: Please give consent in Settings first.

why.distress: Only when your child is calm (0 or 1).
why.too-soon: Only one step up per day.
why.at-ceiling: This is the highest practice level.

exposure.ownTitle: Use a recording of the real sound
exposure.ownBody: Record the sound your child finds hard (up to 20 seconds), for example your own blender. It stays on this phone. It will be played at the same very soft practice level, with the same stop rules.
exposure.ownSaved: Saved on this phone. 'Our own recording' is now selected.

review.title: Your review
review.heading: HarmonyPath review {start} to {end}
review.inWindow: This covers 8–12 weeks, a good time to review with your child's therapist.
review.early: This covers {w} weeks. A full review is most useful after 8–12 weeks.
review.edit: Summary (you can edit this before sharing)

learn.title: Learn
learn.interventions: Types of music and sound support
learn.notOffered: This app explains this programme but does not offer it.

redflags.intro: Answer a few questions about a programme you've heard of. We'll compare it with the warning signs in the research.

therapist.noRankings: Official registers only. We do not rank or recommend individual therapists.

coach.title: Ask the coach
coach.disclosure: I'm an AI helper, not a clinician. I answer only from the app's approved guidance and show my sources. For medical questions, please ask your child's doctor.
coach.offline: Works offline. Your questions are not stored or sent anywhere.
coach.emergency: If anyone is in danger or hurt right now, call {number}.

settings.title: Settings

consent.none: Consent: not given. Nothing about your child is stored.
consent.granted: Consent: given. Data is stored on this device only.
consent.withdrawn: Consent: withdrawn. Nothing new is being stored.

settings.localOnly: Everything stays on this device. There are no ads, trackers or analytics.
settings.retention: Logs are deleted after 12 months, and the sound diary after 90 days.
settings.audit: Privacy log: {n} entries ({ok}). It contains no personal details.
settings.withdrawn: Consent withdrawn. Nothing new will be stored.
settings.confirmDelete: Delete everything on this device? This cannot be undone.
settings.headphones: Child Mode has its own lower volume limit. Use headphones made for children that limit volume to 85 dB or less.
settings.coachOffline: The coach works offline, from approved guidance only. An optional AI-writing mode may come later; it will be off unless you switch it on.

gate.title: For grown-ups
gate.explain: Please answer this question to continue.
gate.wrong: Not quite. Here is a new question.
gate.locked: Too many tries. Please wait one minute.

child.grownups: Grown-ups: press and hold to leave Child Mode
child.quietBody: All sound is off. You did the right thing.

childNotice.title: Before Child Mode
childNotice.headphones: Use headphones made for children that limit volume to 85 dB or less. Keep your device volume moderate. Child Mode also has its own lower volume limit.
childNotice.stop: The red Stop bar at the top stops all sound at once.
childNotice.exit: To leave Child Mode, press and hold 'Grown-ups' for 2 seconds, then answer the question.
childNotice.pin: For extra safety, you can turn on your phone's Guided Access or Screen Pinning.
